title: JDY-31A V2.241 (SPP + BLE)
notes: JDY-31A V2.241 / Bluetooth 3.0+BLE. Five UART AT reads are PHYSICALLY VERIFIED at 9600 8N1 CRLF. NAME/PIN/BAUD setters use the documented legacy JDY-31 syntax (AT+TOKENvalue, no '='); setter behavior on this exact firmware is NOT YET physically accepted. Writes require an explicit version check, pre-read, acknowledgment and verification or pending power-cycle. Only UART/SPP parameters are shown here; BLE GATT is a separate protocol and must be investigated separately. No unverified commands, reset or automatic settings writes. Adapter VCC 3.6-6 V, UART level 3.3 V.

edit.hint: JDY-31 syntax: AT+NAME followed immediately by a 1..18 byte ASCII name (no equals sign). After write, verify by AT+NAME; reconnect or power-cycle if the phone caches the old advertisement.
Changes UART baud index (4..9) for the next session. Confirm before sending: after power-cycle, change the PC COM baud to the selected rate; immediate readback may be unavailable.
Changes the SPP pairing PIN, exactly four decimal digits. Re-pair bonded devices if needed. Values must not be published.
